excerpts.text:
Crucis is an independent framework for auditing causal discovery systems and
their claims. It preserves native evidence and declared uncertainty, supports
controlled comparisons, and produces traceable findings and reports.

The framework, its evaluation suite and its paper share the Crucis identity,
inspired by the *instantia crucis*: evidence that discriminates between competing
explanations. This repository is the extracted development version. Protocol,
implemented support and empirical coverage are versioned separately.

The opt-in S3 layer provides durable execution accounts, admission and owner
controls, guarded native dispatch, capture and interaction, recovery and immutable
evidence publication. Its CLI inspects and plans from supplied bytes; live drivers,
authority and policy implementations are explicitly injected in Python. See the
[execution guide](crucis_causal/execution/README.md) for the four controlled
mechanism profiles and their scientific and operational limits. Those fixture
results do not establish universal native-system or causal-correctness coverage.

excerpts.text:
The user selected **validated controlled cases first**, retaining CausalArena
graph-label agreement as a separate diagnostic lane. This accepts the first
matched pilot's reference basis. It does not authorize a paid run, scored
assignment, sealed reserve access, changed scientific scoring or paper port.

Source-validated controlled cases provide an explicit mechanism, independently
checked reference and scoped source warrant before a paid comparison. A modified
or newly authored mechanism receives its own controlled-case identity. It is not
silently described as an official CausalArena instance or measured-world truth.

The strongest alternative was to run existing CausalArena label-agreement
diagnostics first. That would reach larger benchmark inputs sooner and avoid
introducing a controlled generator population. It would measure reference-label
sensitivity, availability and work, while leaving primary warranted-benefit/harm
eligibility open. The accepted direction prioritizes evidence for those primary
questions without discarding the diagnostic lane.

Controlled cases cost additional reference qualification and cannot alone support
claims of broad benchmark coverage or transfer. The independent unit remains the
source scenario/block, with alternative worlds, arms, edits, draws and resamplings
kept within its declared lineage. An exposed development specimen is not a
reserved study unit or a population-variance estimate.

excerpts.text:
Under do(X=x), the source and triangle have identical entire Y distributions:
Y=x+U_M+U_Y in C0/C1 and Y=x+Z+U_M+U_Y in C2. This is equality of the selected
Y law for every x, not equality of every interventional joint distribution.
The fork's Y law is independent of do(X), giving P(Y>0)=1/2 at both doses.

For two uniforms, use the triangular CDF. For three, the exact CDF is
`sum_{j=0}^3 (-1)^j choose(3,j) max(t+3-2j,0)^3 / 48`.
It follows that the R_H probabilities are 23/32,9/32 in C0/C1 and
131/192,61/192 in C2. The compatible triangle differs on direct X->Y, so the
qualified R_H basis does not identify directness. Its nonzero response does
establish ancestry; acyclicity excludes the reverse Y->X.

Under R_B's complete clamps, the source M=x+U_M gives 3/4,1/4. A nonzero
response while every other endogenous variable is fixed requires an active
direct X parent of M in the declared modular class. The fork gives 1/2,1/2;
the triangle gives 2/3,1/3, so these witnesses are incompatible with that record.
The reverse M->X is excluded by acyclicity. Missing clamps, changed doses,
thresholds, coordinates, source-specific probabilities or class bindings do not
inherit this qualification. Other questions remain unresolved without a scoped
identification proof or valid disagreement witness.

Full observational-law equality is stronger than matching a particular finite
CSV. These proofs do not establish ideal iid sampling by PCG64, successful input
release, faithful native preprocessing, actual information receipt/use, a native
claim of certainty, nominal Fisher-z calibration, or a real-world causal truth.
Those are separate claims and gates. The source's active-parent truth and an
answer's warrant in the broad admitted class are separate outcomes.

excerpts.text:
The common continuous core now supports the chain, middle-variable branch and
second-parent collider. Their equations, role/noise order and raw bounds are
closed trusted recipes. The new codec is explicitly selected:

```python
from crucis_causal.continuous import records, recipes

wire = records.for_profile(recipes.DIVERSE)
wire.install(payloads)  # supplied host registry; does not dispatch anything
```

Fifteen scalar forms use `0.1.0-proposal.3`; Plan, LaunchSchedule and AnalyticRecord
use `0.2.0-proposal.3`. The v4 catalog admits nine named model families: three
sources and their reference-only fork/triangle witnesses. Generation accepts
the three sources only. Legacy defaults, the old catalog, four-unit rejection
and C0 cell/CSV bytes remain at their original boundary. Mixed versions are not
silently promoted. Unknown recipe/version names cannot load executable code.
The compatibility check also executed the unchanged numeric implementation from
pre-build commit `1b565a47` on both public fixed tapes. Cell and CSV bytes matched;
the resulting original-source hashes are retained as regression expectations.

The S4 path uses the original captured scope wire. Controlled B1 arrows yield
supported resolution; H1 direct arrows remain unwarranted under R_H. Matched
H0/H1 fixtures retain the same case, domain and analytic record while changing
the fallible comment and workflow occurrence identities. Missing output retains
an outcome range. A genuine controlled B0 ingress/continuation account establishes
absence of added premises; it does not infer absence from an unread document.
Wrong intact class and variable-map joins reject. These are hand-specified
output controls, not observed model behavior or estimated treatment effects.

The combined continuous regression ran 72 tests without failures, errors or
skips. Its controlled counters recorded 62 fixture derivations and 107 full
checks, below the fixed 64/128 caps for that process. Additional original-source
byte expectations and expanded all-pair truth checks passed separately. The
final repository gates include those additions; the local gate receipts record
their exact tree, totals and availability skips.

No new S5/S6 reporting chain or canonical S7 assessment/key roster is claimed.
Before issuing native scientific findings, qualify the actual selected
measurement–finding–report–validation path and its independent expected outcomes.
Existing component tests or the separate candidate-duty blueprint cannot create
an accepted denominator or framework-wide correctness percentage.

The proposed six development blocks remain two draws in each of three fixed,
related source strata. They are not main-study N, random mechanisms, ideal iid
sampling proved by distinct seeds, or a way to give knowledge-only systems
variance from CSVs they never receive. Other system/task/reference lanes retain
their own qualification plans. Mathematical source claims do not establish
physical causal truth, finite-sample rank, faithfulness, nominal test calibration,
information use/comprehension or universal isolation.
The raw role/column order is fixed in these profiles; additional presentations
or transformations require their own realization, mapping and applicability checks.

excerpts.text:
Keep scientific applicability, operational readiness, permission and observed
effects separate. A source-backed reference can exist before a runnable driver;
a completed native workflow can lack the meaning/reference needed for a requested
score. An installed adapter name establishes neither property.

For each requested use, bind system/version, product/stage/field, variable map,
question, reference/model class, information basis, audience and cutoff. State
which existing receipts transfer and why. Preserve unsupported and unresolved
frontiers. A roster inventory is not a performance denominator or a claim to cover
every discovery system or dataset.

An assigned failure or invalid native answer stays in the intended study frame.
For example, a cyclic answer to a DAG task can be a task-fulfillment failure even
when an ordering metric cannot accept it. Withholding that metric does not delete
the unit. Pre-assignment scope selection and post-assignment outcome handling
must not be conflated.

The completed Copilot feasibility block used one exposed continuous input. Its
eight workflows, eighty actual provider requests and 168 native fit entries are
different work units, not eight, eighty or 168 independent source cases. Sixteen
typed graph objects were resolved; global family assurance remained unknown.
No benefit/harm, population or main-study precision estimate was issued.

**Truth and warrant have separate paths.** A truth-only error can be decided with
EG04 while EG05 remains unresolved. An unsupported-positive endpoint can be
decided with EG05 while actual truth remains unknown. The combined warranted-
resolution endpoint requires both of its premises. Unknown proof search is not
an ambiguity witness, and a true estimate is not automatically a warranted claim.
Existing `measurement/direct_claims.py` already implements separate signed
outcomes; qualifying the assembled use is a different obligation.

excerpts.text:
The Q1 goal is an independently auditable account of how discovery systems use
knowledge, accept or reject edits, and seek information or abstain, with a versioned
benchmark and validation of Crucis itself. Q1 should inform concrete Q2 design
choices. It cannot identify a universally optimal causal discovery system from
a finite sample. S1--S7 are built at documented support profiles. The continuous
T00--RC5 extension is also built; do not restart either implementation DAG.

The finish line is a finite, qualified multi-system Q1 study and benchmark edition
with scoped findings, uncertainty/holds and limitations, plus a source-linked
paper handoff. Every system on the roster gets a coverage disposition; it need
not run on an incompatible task. Universal support and a complete Cartesian
product of all systems/datasets are not exit criteria.

## Milestone DAG and single next action

```
M1: one development emission/cohort
  -> M2: minimum free native qualification
    -> M3: bounded paid feasibility/sizing tranche
      -> M4: targeted independent-case/system expansion and sizing
        -> M5: prospective main-study freeze
          -> M6: separately authorized larger waves and synthesis
```

Free source/reference and roster inventory in M4 can proceed alongside M1/M2
when it uses no new input generation, native launch, sealed access or spend.
It must not delay the critical path for unrelated completeness. Each finished
milestone has a closure receipt; reuse it unless the consuming pins, scope,
cutoff, audience or authority require a new check. Do not repeat whole gates
merely because a new planning document was opened. Repository commit checks
remain mandatory for each actual local change.

excerpts.text:
The initial selected native graph had an undirected U–V edge; the converted
representation and later revised graph were preserved separately. The revised
graph was empty. This demonstrates why a study must capture intermediate and
final native objects rather than infer final behavior from a model reply or
initial fit. It is not a scored causal finding, an effect of genuine model
advice or a population claim.

The returned bootstrap recommendation classified the edge as low probability
using the directed-edge probability, despite a retained undirected-edge
probability of one. Native quality-judge control flow deletes such an edge.
The later model-edit dictionaries and KCI-forbid dictionary were empty, and
cycle processing returned the empty graph. Attribution to the bootstrap pruning
loop is a source-control-flow inference anchored to these records: there is no
snapshot immediately after that loop. No native repair or scientific harm
claim is adopted here.

## What the checks do and do not establish

These fixtures use actual local numerical checking, immutable storage, SQLite
history, subprocess execution, S4 calculations, S5 decisions and S6 presentation
verification. Their scientific inputs reuse two public fixed tapes. Their release
and assignment histories are explicitly simulated. Their native environment,
provider and account metadata are placeholders on a non-dispatchable fixture
profile. They provide no new independent scientific observations, native fits,
model responses, paid sizing estimates or main-study sample size.

The new direct-claim controls have a deliberately narrow oracle: fixed three-source
direct-benefit and path-overreach cases. Truth and evidential warrant qualify
separately. The generic S7 packets expose unresolved coverage; they do not modify
the legacy K10/K12 executable grid or issue a framework-wide correctness rate.

## Verification receipts

The current stable-source controlled run passed **70 tests, zero failures, zero
errors and zero skips** through an actual separate ordinary test process. Its
before/after source manifests match, and the actual started test identities match
the expected set. The child test process recorded 17 derivations and 16 full
checks against its unchanged 64/128 caps. Parent counters stayed unchanged.
The index pins the qualification, child reply and host accounting receipts.

The 70 include the installed-wheel control, actual owned subprocess controls,
six SQLite persistence controls, two storage controls and three test-isolation
controls. Earlier passing 65-test, two-storage-test and three-isolation-test
receipts overlap this current run and are not added to its denominator. Tests
are not scientific cases or sixteen independent CP observations.

## What follows this build

1. Separately admit the six actual development input/assignment realizations,
   keeping each material proof and every held occurrence in the complete account.
2. Qualify the actual native environment and the three-input, eight-workflow free
   route against those exact inputs and delivery/output/reference boundaries.
3. Admit a bounded single-input, eight-workflow paid sizing window only against
   current account authority, remaining cumulative spending and window limits.
4. Extend sizing across the admitted development cases. Estimate paired benefit,
   harm, costs, failures and between-case variability without treating workflow
   arms or repeated fixture tapes as independent cases.
5. Freeze the main-study population, comparison eligibility, precision, stopping
   and budget. Other systems and datasets retain their own qualification lanes;
   this Copilot bridge does not narrow the study to Copilot or qualify all systems.

sources.title: Why the study tests Crucis too—and how sizing is justified
sources.primary_access: bundled exact project-owned excerpts; remote commit availability not assumed
sources.evidence_level: Selected source account, not a reproduced runtime finding or scientific adoption
sources.supports: The scoped scientific aims, separation of calibration and study observations, multi-case sizing inputs, independent units, main freeze and missing-evidence-directed expansion.
sources.limits: Versioned planning account, not an adopted main N, power calculation, spending authorization, completed study or favorable validation of Crucis.

excerpts.text:
The Q1 goal is an independently auditable account of how discovery systems use
knowledge, accept or reject edits, and seek information or abstain, with a versioned
benchmark and validation of Crucis itself. Q1 should inform concrete Q2 design
choices. It cannot identify a universally optimal causal discovery system from
a finite sample. S1--S7 are built at documented support profiles. The continuous
T00--RC5 extension is also built; do not restart either implementation DAG.

Preserve the accepted directions:

- Stock automatic Copilot graph workflow primary; configured PC diagnostic;
  application reports/discussion audited separately.
- Delivered-evidence variant separately attributed; whole-workflow evidence
  support primary, stage-visible evidence diagnostic; delivery is not comprehension.
- Direct-edge benefit B1 versus B0; total-effect-overreach harm H1 versus H0;
  unsupported edge assertions lead, denials/truth errors/withholding separate.
- Scoped paired estimates with uncertainty first. Old illustrative margins,
  powers and N are not adopted. Routine-follow-up comparison stays secondary.
- Controlled reference first. Mechanism/label disagreement does not become causal
  correctness by using the label as truth. Partial, missing and uncertain outcomes
  retain their meanings and intended denominators.
- Unit, source family, draw, model repetition and execution attempt are different
  identities. No extra independence follows from having more run folders.

### M4.3: measured sizing and a bounded expansion proposal

After M3, propose a **small multi-case sizing tranche**, with new independent
source-case supply or explicitly clustered cases, before any main N is selected.
Specify candidate count and hard assigned cap from the actual eligible inventory,
not a generic 16-block tradition. Set a finite number of development tranches and
total ceiling in that proposal. No open-ended pilot loop or automatic doubling.

Use pilot information to choose among more source cases, repeated draws within
a source, repeated native/model sampling, or a missing system/reference route:

- Mostly route/readiness holds -> fix/qualify the named mechanics free; do not
  buy more repetitions hoping the route happens not to be selected.
- High within-case model variation -> limited repetitions can measure it, while
  keeping their parent case/cluster identity. They do not replace case diversity.
- Between-case/family variation dominates -> prioritize eligible new cases and
  source-family coverage over repeats on one convenient chain.
- Low paired adjudicability -> diagnose delivery/reference/output coverage and
  retain full-frame ranges; a bigger complete-case count alone cannot fix bias.
- Good mechanics and adequate reference coverage -> update per-comparison cost,
  time, completion and paired/cluster variability ranges; prepare M5.

For planning sensitivity only, independent complete paired differences with SD s
and desired approximate 95% half-width h give n about (1.96*s/h)^2. This is not
the adopted analysis, a cluster-adjusted answer, an exact small-sample formula,
or a missingness correction. Uncertainty-method qualification and family/dependence
structure must precede final sizing. Workload division by observed completion is
only an expected cost scenario; it does not restore unidentified outcomes.

Exit: a finite eligible case/system matrix, source-family/cluster definition,
per-comparison supply and adjudicability, low/middle/stressed cost/variance/time
scenarios, explicit thin strata/gaps, and a proposed affordable main core plus
separately priced breadth/sensitivity extensions. If supply is insufficient,
bring the resulting scientific scope decision to the user instead of silently
weakening references or promoting exposed development data to confirmatory.

### M5.1: design freeze checklist

Fix, review and pin all of these together:

1. Target claims, eligible populations, source-family strata and weights; finite
   roster dispositions; primary core versus optional extensions/fallback claims.
2. Independent units, clusters, draws, repetitions, matching and condition order;
   intended slots before seed assignment; precise between-system comparability.
3. Per-comparison endpoints, directions, measurement/reference scope, partial/
   unsupported/absent/abstained meanings; native and variant source identities.
4. Qualified uncertainty/precision analysis, dependence and multiplicity handling;
   main assigned caps and planned complete coverage; formal thresholds only if
   separately adopted. No old illustrative 10/5-point margins inherit authority.
5. Generation supply versus released cohort versus assessable pairs; held,
   failed, disputed, undispatched and unknown effects; missing-outcome ranges
   separate from sampling uncertainty; estimator/denominator policy frozen.
6. Seed owner, access and deterministic assignment map for data/native/order/
   repetitions; main reserves outside the shared workspace, never derived from
   exposed development seeds. Freeze assignment before relevant exposure. Any
   pre-assignment intake reserve rule must be explicit; assigned failures remain.
7. Exact source/environment/data/reference/procedure pins, license/access and
   audience closure; admissible transformations, stage information and action
   menus; replay/restart identity and reconciliation rules.
8. Work/request/token/dollar/exposure and clock ceilings, settlement reserve,
   stopping rule and batch order; no optional stopping at an attractive result
   or after spending an unapproved ceiling. Criteria for changes/new versions.
9. Registration and exposure history per claim. A plan frozen now cannot make
   an already seen development outcome prospective. Record exploratory status.

| Choice | Recommendation / strongest alternative | Cost and failure prevented |
|---|---|---|
| First data | One exposed development assignment / sealed development draw | Avoids new secrecy infrastructure and reserve contamination; no blind-test claim |
| Native checks | Dependency-based checklist in bounded tranches / every route x every condition | Saves redundant native work; uncovered dependencies remain explicit rather than assumed |
| First paid block | Full conservative eight-workflow plan, stopping on first hold / cheaper fixed-stage-only block | Tests the actual primary product and variant while preserving stage diagnostics; no pretending a fixed-stage check evaluates automatic selection |
| Expansion | Additional eligible cases/systems selected by missing evidence / repeated convenient case | Buys independent coverage or variance evidence actually needed; avoids pseudoreplication and a Copilot-only paper |
| Main design | Scoped estimates with uncertainty / formal margin certification | Avoids paying for an unadopted threshold and unsupported large-N promises; formal certification can be proposed separately |
| Scale | Finite core with explicit extensions and wave grants / open-ended pilot ladder | Bounds capital/time, preserves stopping discipline and turns scope/budget conflicts into decisions |

There is no defensible current full-study dollar estimate or main N. These are
outputs of M3/M4 and decisions at M5. Report both expected workload scenarios and
hard authorized ceilings; the former never authorize the latter. Free work means
zero provider spend, not zero local cost. Keep a pilot that holds or finds no
benefit scientifically visible; don't spend merely to chase a favorable result.
